prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: a snowy mountain pass at night. Back (top 42%): a vivid green-teal aurora curtain over jagged snowy peaks, stars, the far slopes bluish. Ground (lower 58%): deep snow with footprints, snowy rocks and frosted fir trees at the sides. Light: aurora and moonlight, cold blue with teal glints. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a wide 16:9 environment-only side-on JRPG battle background. Rich high-resolution 2D PIXEL ART, strongly enforced pixel-grid aesthetic: crisp square pixels, hard edges, no antialiasing, no smooth gradients, no painterly brushwork. Compose as if native 960x540 art pixels, each native pixel represented by a sharp 4x4 display-pixel square. Use deliberate readable pixel clusters, hue-shifted color ramps (violet shadows and slightly warm pale-yellow highlights). An endless-night world where the sun has vanished: snowy mountain pass beneath a starry black-indigo sky. TOP 42%: dramatic vivid green-teal aurora curtains across sky over jagged snow-covered peaks, distant slopes bluish. LOWER 58%: continuous deep-snow ground plane receding from foreground bottom to distant horizon at low three-quarter perspective; sparse footprints, snow-covered rocks and frosted firs framing sides and far distance. Cold blue moonlight and aurora light creating teal glints on snow. IMPORTANT battle staging: middle ground between 55% and 90% image height, particularly the center and right, must be broad, relatively flat, empty, legible and uncluttered, suitable for positioning battle characters; keep rocks, vegetation, debris around edges and far background. No characters, no monsters, no people, no lanterns, no fires, no text, no UI. Atmospheric but sharp and game-ready pixel art.
